description: This file defines the CustomJobParameterRepository interface, which declares methods for saving job parameters and retrieving them by ID within the Fineract infrastructure jobs domain.

classes.name: CustomJobParameterRepository
classes.description: An interface for managing custom job parameters, including saving a set of parameters and finding a parameter by its ID.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a set of JobParameterDTO objects as custom job parameters, returning the ID of the saved entity.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomJobParameter object by its unique identifier, returning an Optional that may be empty if not found.
